articles.title: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
articles.snippet: The 12-month test will put a beta version of the central bank currency through online, mobile, in-store and peer-to-peer payments.

articles.title: Bitcoin gives back Monday's gain as Clarity Act odds fade on Polymarket
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell 1.7% since midnight UTC to $76,862, unwinding a late Monday rally as Polymarket odds on the Clarity Act becoming law this year halved overnight.

articles.title: Democrats send counteroffer to Republicans over Clarity Act provisions
articles.snippet: Democratic Senators were said to be meeting late Monday to discuss the latest proposed draft text.

articles.title: US Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: The failed procedural vote leaves the CLARITY Act facing an uncertain future after months of negotiations over crypto oversight and ethics provisions.

articles.title: Bitcoin short-term holders hit 30-day profit streak as bull-market odds improve: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: Bitcoin short-term holders approached a full month in partial profit as analysis saw improving odds of an enduring bullish BTC price reversal.
